title: Cofinal-tail continuity of Hom between perfect complexes
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preordered set, $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram with colimit cocone $c$ and colimit ring $A$, $i\in I$, and $s:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$ locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-pc-scheme]. Assume the scheme derived categories and the derived categories on the localized open sites of X exist [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $P,Q\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ be perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Use the schemes, direct pullbacks and canonical conjugated Hom transport $T$ of [lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport]. Then (1) for every $j_0\ge i$ and every $\varphi:P_\infty\to Q_\infty$ there are $j\ge j_0$ and $a:P_j\to Q_j$ such that $T_{j,\infty}(a)=\varphi$; (2) whenever $a,b:P_j\to Q_j$ have equal images under $T_{j,\infty}$, there exists $k\ge j$ such that $T_{j,l}(a)=T_{j,l}(b)$ for every $l\ge k$. This statement does not assert descent of inverses or simultaneous satisfaction of a finite set of relations.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.29.2, Tag 09RE, label lemma-descend-homomorphisms (full faithfulness), used in Lemma 36.29.3, Tag 09RF

proof.text: Set the open predicate to PerfectHomContinuityOn. The affine-open hypothesis of quasiCompactOpen_induction is perfect_hom_continuity_affine and its union hypothesis is perfect_hom_continuity_union.

The structure map s to an affine scheme makes X compact and quasi-separated (Mathlib QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace and quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated). Apply quasiCompactOpen_induction to the compact top open.

The identity open immersion of X has image the top open, and identity composed with s is s. Specialize the quantified predicate at Y=X, t=id, s_Y=s and the given perfect P,Q. Its two clauses are definitionally the required conclusion.

lean.statement: theorem perfect_hom_continuity {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c) (i : I) (X : Scheme.{u}) (s : X ⟶ Spec (R.obj i)) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s] [QuasiCompact s] [QuasiSeparated s] [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))] [∀ U : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))] (P Q : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hP : X.IsPerfect P) (hQ : X.IsPerfect Q) : (∀ (j₀ : I) (hij₀ : i ≤ j₀) (φ : (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))).obj P ⟶ (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))).obj Q), ∃ (j : I) (hj₀j : j₀ ≤ j) (f : (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij₀.trans hj₀j)))))).obj P ⟶ (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij₀.trans hj₀j)))))).obj Q), perfectLimitMap R c s (hij₀.trans hj₀j) f = φ) ∧ (∀ (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j) (a b : (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))).obj P ⟶ (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))).obj Q), perfectLimitMap R c s hij a = perfectLimitMap R c s hij b → ∃ (k : I) (hjk : j ≤ k), ∀ (l : I) (hkl : k ≤ l), perfectStageMap R s hij (hjk.trans hkl) a = perfectStageMap R s hij (hjk.trans hkl) b)
